'''Jargridian Brandy''' was a type of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage from the [[Jargridia system/Legends|Jargridia system]] whose continued consumption was liable to accelerate the accumulation of fat around the [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] area of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Such was the case with [[Brooser]].
